questions.ask: Alice wants to send Bob a secret message. Which key should she encrypt it with?
Why can't Alice just send the key along with the message?
answers: Anyone who intercepts the message also gets the key, so they can decrypt it. The key needs a separate, safe way to reach Bob.

questions.ask: Your school wants to protect student records. What would you recommend?
answers: Encrypt the records, and give keys only to staff who need them. Store keys apart from the data, and keep a secure backup so a lost key doesn't mean lost records.

answers: It decrypts messages that were encrypted with the matching public key.
